Intro

  • Tofranil (Imipramine) is a tricyclic antidepressant that is used in treatment of depression and anxiety.
  • it works by blocking the reuptake of norepinephrine and serotonin, it also blocks the muscarinic receptors leading to antimuscarinic effects, and it blocks the alpha 1 and 2 adrenergic and H1 receptors.
  • In this video, I will talk about the side effects of this medication

1. Antihistaminic side effects

  • Dizziness
  • Sedation
  • Confusion
  • Increased appetite and weight gain

2. Antimuscarinic side effects

  • Blurred vision
  • Constipation
  • Tachycardia
  • Confusion
  • Dry mouth
  • Urinary retention
  • Cognitive impairment
  • Narrow angle glaucoma
  • Paralytic ileus

3. Cardiovascular effects

Imipramine effect on the CVS system are due to its blockade of adrenergic receptors and its blockade of the sodium channels in the heart (same as the quinidine medication), those effects include:

  • Orthostatic hypotension: blockade of alpha 1 adrenergic receptors lead to vasodilatation and reduced BP upon standing
  • Arrhythmias: caused by direct cardiac sodium channel blockade leading to conduction abnormalities
  • QT prolongation: due to blockade of cardiac potassium channels

4. Psychiatric side effects

  • Mania and hypomania: due to increased levels of norepinephrine and serotonin can precipitate manic episodes
  • Agitation: due to increased serotonin and noradrenaline levels
  • Delirium: due to anticholinergic activity and possibly direct effects on the CNS

5. Tremors (jitteriness)

  • It is thought that tremors cause is related to serotonin and norepinephrine systems

6. Mild elevation in liver enzymes

  • Because It is metabolized in the liver, and it might lead to liver damage and elevated liver enzymes

7. Sexual dysfunction

  • Include impaired arousal and orgasms
  • Caused by increased the serotonin levels

8. Diaphoresis

  • Caused by noradrenergic receptor manipulation

9. Hematological effects

  • Leukopenia, thrombocytopenia and agranulocytosis
  • these effects are rare and it is thought that they are caused by some autoimmune mechanisms on the bone marrow precipitated by this medications

10. Serotonin syndrome

  • Caused by increased the serotonin levels
  • Occurs in case of concurrent use with other drugs that elevate the serotonin levels like the SSRI, triptans, tramadol, lithium, St John’s wort and tryptophan
  • Symptoms of serotonin syndrome include altered metnal status, autonomic changes such as tachycardia and neuromuscular changes such as tremor, rigidity and myoclonus

11. Seizures

  • Imipramine lowers the seizure threshold by altering the neurotransmitter levels and increases the neuronal excitability
  • This will increase the risk of seizures especially in susceptible people
